title: Cash-Waqfs as a Source of Entrepreneurial Credit for Merchants involved in Trade between Bosnia and Venice in the Early Modern Era
lineage: Inspected the author’s two-page conference abstract, not the underlying register.

passages.note: Stefini identifies an archival register of capital lent by Bosnian waqfs to merchants whose goods were stolen in 1587, among other Venetian and Ottoman records; the abstract does not give individual amounts, full admission criteria or prove that a particular Sarajevo waqf appears in this register. Full paper and underlying register were not inspected.
